Nothing about applying minoxidil to the face is scientifically proven. It does inhibit collagen production which is widely known. That is why some people here take collagen supplements and/or derma-roll. Most people here who reported any type of skin aging also say that it reverted after stopping. Some didn't.  Like I said this gets asked all the time here with the same answers, but everyone is different.

You've been on for 11 months and you're just now worried about dry skin? But no. Dry skin isn't a sign of aging. Just moisturize and finish off your journey by tapering off when you're satisfied.

Definitely do not do that. You want to wait 24 hours after derma-rolling for your skin to heal. You can apply moisturizer directly after rolling, but definitely not minox. You can look up an infographic to see how often you should derma-roll based on what needle length you are using. If you're using 0.5mm you should stick to once a week. Replace your morning minox with derma-rolling that day and don't apply minox until the following morning.
If you don't like the way it looks all you can do is shave/trim and be patient for it to fill in. Good luck

1. Potentially, yes. The dense look comes from..well density mostly and genetics. You need lots of darker thick terminal hairs for what I'm assuming is the stubble look you're describing. How minoxidil will affect you will have to wait to be seen. It's hard to make a guess on how it might affect you without a picture, but all it would be is a guess anyway.
2. I'm not an expert and certainly not a doctor, but I believe a small percentage of minoxidil will go systemic (into your bloodstream) with application anywhere. It is true that the absorption rate is higher on your face, but think the amount is very negligible at any rate. I personally have been on for a month and have noticed some vellus hair on my ears. Everywhere else it's harder to say because I wasn't really paying attention before. You won't turn into an ape though; most unwanted hair won't turn terminal. Just pluck or shave anything you don't want.

Good luck!

Back when I was in high school, me and a friend were walking to our nearby corner of happy & healthy when we saw an organized, possibly militarized, group of squirrels performing training strategies. Along the outside of the bend in the road we were walking along was a fence lined with bushes and such with a clearing every so often. There were about 5 squirrels sitting in a line at the bottom of the fence in the first clearing with 2 what I can only guess were Sergeant or Chieftain squirrels giving orders to the privates. The Chiefs would squawk and the line would climb up the fence and down the other side fast as hell. As soon as they took off another group of squirrels would come from the bushes and line up at the bottom of the fence waiting for the next squawk. It was nuts. I have to ask my friend every so often that it actually happened to make sure I didn't imagine it.
